data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church that has raised $555M+ to date and carries a reported post-money valuation of $10.32B. The valuation universe for Biotech & Health comprises 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience.

Three standard valuation methods were evaluated. Stage-progression analysis was rejected because the $10.32B base valuation, when stepped forward by a typical 1.7x Series C multiplier, implies $17.5B—more than 20x the company's total raised capital, suggesting the reported figure may be mis-parsed. Peer-median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables; while 6 same-sector peers exist, clustering by stage or valuation tier yielded fewer than 3 datapoints in any filtered bucket. Public-comp anchoring using the Biotech & Health sector P/S median of 7.4x across the three listed tickers could not proceed absent the target's revenue disclosure, which private companies typically withhold.

The data does not support a triangulated valuation range. Pending disclosure of either trailing twelve-month revenue or a credible recalibration of the reported post-money valuation, further quantitative analysis is not feasible. Key uncertainties center on whether the $10.32B figure reflects an actual closing price or a data error, and whether comparable private biotech companies in the dataset have disclosed sufficient operating metrics to anchor a range.
